overview.studentSubtitle: Here's where your research search stands.
overview.professorSubtitle: Manage your lab, openings and applicants.
overview.completeBody: Professors see your profile with every application, and matching gets sharper the more you share.
overview.discoverBody: Turn on discoverability and verified professors can invite you to apply. Your email stays private until you reply.
overview.matchBody: See positions and professors ranked by how well they fit you.
overview.createLabTitle: Set up your lab to start recruiting
overview.createLabBody: Students see your lab profile and research on every position you post.
overview.unverifiedBody: We review professor accounts before labs and positions become public. You can prepare everything in the meantime.
overview.talentBody: Describe your ideal student and let AI rank the students who opted in.

profile.title: My profile
profile.subtitle: Professors see this with your application, and AI Match uses it to find your fit.
profile.bioHint: Who are you, and what are you curious about?
profile.skillsHint: Comma-separated, e.g. Python, PyTorch, R, lab safety
profile.interestsHint: Topics you'd love to work on, e.g. computer vision, cell fate.
profile.experienceHint: Projects, courses, past research — the more concrete, the better the match.
profile.availability: Hours per week you can commit
profile.workStyleHint: Move each dial to where you're most comfortable. It's used to compare you with labs.
profile.resumeHint: A link to a PDF (Drive, Dropbox, your site).
profile.discoverableDesc: Professors can see your profile and invite you to apply. Your email stays private until you reply. You can switch this off any time.
profile.welcome: Welcome to Labora! Tell us about yourself to get better matches.

applications.title: Applications
applications.subtitle: Everything you've applied to, in one place.
applications.emptyBody: When you apply to a position, it shows up here so you can track its status.

invitations.title: Invitations
invitations.subtitleStudent: Professors who'd like you to apply.
invitations.emptyStudentBody: Turn on discoverability in your profile to let verified professors invite you.
invitations.emptyProfessorBody: Use “Find students” to discover students who fit your lab.
invitations.replyPlaceholder: Add a note to the professor (optional)
invitations.accepted: You accepted — an application was created.

outreach.title: Outreach tracker
outreach.subtitle: Log who you've contacted, when to follow up, and what happened.
outreach.emptyBody: Add researchers from their profile to keep tabs on your outreach and get follow-up dates.
outreach.removeConfirm: Remove this researcher from your tracker?
outreach.helpBody: Reply rates shown on researcher profiles come from anonymous, aggregated outreach logs like yours — no individual entry is ever shown.

saved.title: Saved
saved.subtitle: Researchers and positions you've bookmarked.
saved.emptyProfessorsBody: Tap the bookmark on any researcher to add them to your shortlist.
saved.emptyPositionsBody: Tap the bookmark on a position to keep it for later.

billing.title: Plan & billing
billing.subtitle: Your access, usage and referral rewards.
billing.referralBody: Share your code. When a friend signs up with it, you both get {days} days of Pro.
billing.redeemedOk: Code redeemed — {days} days of Pro added.
billing.checkoutSuccess: Thanks! Your plan will be active in a moment.
billing.devMode: Payments aren't connected in this environment — plans activate instantly for testing.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Your account, language and security.
settings.name: Full name
settings.languageHint: Also used for AI-written summaries and feedback.
settings.dangerBody: This permanently removes your profile, applications and everything attached to your account. It can't be undone.

lab.title: Lab & research
lab.subtitle: This is what students see when they consider your positions.
lab.name: Lab name
lab.descriptionHint: What does your lab work on? Keep it approachable for undergraduates.
lab.culture: What it's like to work here
lab.cultureHint: Mentoring style, meeting rhythm, what students own. Students value honesty.
lab.workStyleHint: Used to compare working styles with students.
lab.openalexHint: Optional. Links your Labora lab to your publication profile (starts with A…).
lab.created: Lab created — now add research materials and post a position.
lab.materialsHint: Share papers, datasets or posters so students can learn about your work.
lab.verificationBody: Your lab becomes public once we've verified your professor account. Add a lab website to speed this up.

positions.title: Positions
positions.subtitle: Your openings and who has applied.
positions.emptyBody: Post an opening and start receiving applications.
positions.deleteConfirm: Delete this position? This can't be undone.
positions.newSubtitle: Describe the opening. You can edit it any time.
positions.needLab: You need a lab profile before posting.
positions.noApplicantsBody: Share your position or invite students who fit with “Find students”.

form.title: Position title
form.descriptionHint: What will the student work on? What will they learn?
form.skillsHint: Comma-separated — used for matching, e.g. python, pytorch

admin.title: Admin
admin.subtitle: Verify professors and review what people are sending in.
admin.notAdmin: This area is for administrators only.
